purpose: Define a source-locked, market-isolated path for replacing Graham's provisional generic domestic home-field allowance with a current team/stadium/season location calibration while preserving neutral-site handling, exact fair arithmetic, carried team ratings, personnel overlays, and separate S/W game-factor authority.

sourceAuthority.primary: Billy Walters with Armen Keteyian, Gambler, Chapters 21-22

bookExact.rule: NFL home-field advantage is not a fixed three points; it changes over time and differs by city/team. Geography, home familiarity, attendance and fan environment may matter.
Home advantage is a distinct point-spread-equivalent game component, separate from team strength, game-specific factors and injuries, and it may vary by both the home and away team.
The 2.0-point home advantage is a worked-example assumption for True Game Performance Level calculations, not a universal production default.

calibrationPlan.rule: CURRENT-CALIBRATED home advantage must be estimated as a team/stadium/season effect with shrinkage toward the league level; the two-point book value remains example-only.

BOOK_EXACT.rule: Use 2.0 only when reproducing the source worked example.

SUPPLEMENTAL.rule: Outside home/road ratings may challenge or diagnose the independent estimate only after the independent HFA result is frozen.

currentLiveBaseline.homeSpreadConvention: A positive home advantage makes the home fair spread more negative; pointsToHomeSpread = -homeLocationAdvantagePoints.
currentLiveBaseline.neutralSiteRule: Explicit neutral-site games retain zero base home advantage unless a separately governed venue-specific differential is established.
currentLiveBaseline.rule: H1-H3 may compare against the live 1.5-point domestic placeholder but may not replace or mutate it.

marketIsolation.rule: Historical and active-week HFA estimation must use football results, venue identity and predeclared non-market contextual facts only. Sportsbook fields present in a source dataset must be excluded by field whitelist.

historicalDataContract.preferredSource: nflverse schedule/results data with pinned snapshot/version

initialTrainingWindow.reason: Avoid the COVID attendance regime and reserve 2025 as the first held-out validation season.

initialValidationWindow.rule: Do not tune the final H2 release on the held-out validation season after reading its evaluation.

historicalDataContract.nuisanceControlRule: Nuisance controls may be used only to isolate persistent home/venue effects. Their fitted coefficients receive no S-factor or W-factor production authority from this calibration.
historicalDataContract.missingnessPolicy: A game with unresolved home/away identity, final score, or venue classification is excluded and counted in the audit rather than imputed.

calibrationStructure.target: Observed home scoring margin after accounting for independently estimated team-season strength and allowed estimation-only nuisance controls.
calibrationStructure.modelFamily: Hierarchical/ridge partial-pooling model with league baseline plus team/stadium/season deviations; exact fitting implementation and regularization are locked in H2 before the held-out result is evaluated.
calibrationStructure.leagueBaseline: Estimate a current league-level home advantage rather than importing the 2.0 worked example or the live 1.5 placeholder.
calibrationStructure.teamVenueDeviation: Estimate persistent home-team/stadium deviation and shrink small/noisy samples toward the league baseline.
calibrationStructure.visitorRoadDeviation: A visitor-specific road tendency may be estimated only when identifiable under the same regularized model; otherwise return zero-with-uncertainty rather than inventing a road coefficient.
calibrationStructure.seasonEvolution: Permit season-level movement around the league baseline so home advantage can change over time without silently rewriting historical releases.
calibrationStructure.newStadiumPolicy: A new or materially changed stadium receives strong shrinkage and explicit NEW_VENUE uncertainty; historical team effects may inform but may not be treated as full new-stadium evidence.
calibrationStructure.outputConvention: homeLocationAdvantagePoints > 0 benefits the home team; pointsToHomeSpread = -homeLocationAdvantagePoints.
calibrationStructure.precision: Preserve at least tenth-point internal HFA values and exact Graham arithmetic before half-point display rounding.

venueClassification.DOMESTIC_HOME: Normal designated home-team game at the club's governed home venue.
venueClassification.NEUTRAL: True neutral-site game; base home advantage = 0.
venueClassification.INTERNATIONAL_NEUTRAL: International game with no accepted local-home differential; base home advantage = 0 and travel/time-zone effects remain outside HFA.
venueClassification.RELOCATED_HOME: Designated home game moved away from the governed home venue; requires explicit venue review and cannot inherit the normal home value automatically.
venueClassification.SHARED_VENUE_OR_METRO: Same-stadium or same-metro opponent situation; requires explicit classification and may not blindly use ordinary home value.
venueClassification.NEW_VENUE: First-season/materially changed stadium; use strong shrinkage and elevated uncertainty.
venueClassification.UNRESOLVED: Fail closed; preserve prior governed fair.

doubleCountGuard.teamStrength: Home advantage is a game-specific location term and never changes carried currentRating.
doubleCountGuard.personnel: Personnel and matchup overlays remain separate and must survive any later HFA recomputation unchanged unless their own governed evidence changes.
doubleCountGuard.restTravelTimezone: Rest, travel distance and time-zone effects belong to the future S-factor layer. If used as estimation-only nuisance controls, they may not also be embedded as a named HFA production increment.
doubleCountGuard.weather: Weather and temperature belong to the future W-factor/matchup layer and may not be applied again as HFA.
doubleCountGuard.surface: Turf/surface game factors remain separate from persistent venue calibration unless H2 explicitly proves a stable venue-only component and documents the separation.
doubleCountGuard.supplementalBenchmark: A supplemental published HFA or road rating may not be averaged into, anchor, or overwrite the independent calibrated value.

supplementalBenchmark.source: 2026 VSiN NFL Betting Guide, Steve Makinen home/road field ratings
supplementalBenchmark.currentContext: The guide reports a league home-field level around 2.0 entering 2026 and publishes team-specific home and road field ratings from a prior performance study.
supplementalBenchmark.marketContaminationGuard: Do not use the VSiN values as H2 fitting targets or direct Graham inputs. Compare only after the independent H2 release is frozen.

comparisonBaselines: current live generic 1.5 HFA as diagnostic only
BOOK-EXACT 2.0 worked-example value as diagnostic only
validationRequirements.marketBenchmarkTiming: Any sportsbook/closing-market comparison, if performed at all, occurs only after the HFA release and active-week shadow fairs are frozen and cannot retroactively tune H2/H3.

required: no live board or carried-rating mutation
historical training/validation windows locked before evaluation
